children: GiveDirectly, backed by Canva, is giving eligible adults in two Malawi districts about $700 each with virtually no restrictions on spending, according to Bloomberg.
The amount is roughly equal to Malawi’s annual income per person. Bloomberg reported recipients are using the money for businesses, livestock and home improvements.

title: GEOPOLITICS | GiveDirectly, Canva Back $700 Cash Grants in Malawi
